facts.claim: 기원전 500년경 아테네 암포라, 뾰족 주둥이 작은 개와 μελιταῖε
facts.note: An Attic amphora from about 500 BC shows a small dog with a pointed muzzle with the word μελιταῖε (melitaie).
Greeks also used νανούδιον (nanoúdion), meaning 'dwarf dog.'
Ancient writers variously attribute its origin either to the island of Malta or to the Adriatic island of Mljet.
